items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 73:1
items.html: (To the question) After ZA attains the Gadlut of Neshama, the Nukva begins to be built, and her VAK emerge at once, as above in Answer 200. However, the GAR of the Neshama of ZA she cannot attain, because the GAR of the Neshama are taken by the Malchut of ZA himself, namely the Nukva in his body, from the chest and above. That is, those GAR are concealed Hassadim, like the stature of SAG of Aba and Ima; therefore only the great Nukva in the body of ZA takes from them the aspect of Neshama, because her way is in concealed Hassadim. But for the small Nukva they do not suffice for the aspect of the GAR, because she needs revealed Hassadim, and she has from these Mochin of ZA only the aspect of VAK without a head. (Item 82).
